baseline_models.focus_anchor: The asking verb at word 1 governs أَيَّانَ, while words 3-4 name a day of rising.
baseline_models.mechanism: Ordinary asking seeks the location of the resurrection-event within an open span of time.

activation_trace.role: Asking and requesting supplies the interrogative act and makes temporal information its immediate object.
An open span of time supplies the temporal field within which the question seeks a point.
Resurrection and the rising of the Hour identify the event whose timing is requested.

changed_reading.before: A generic question about the Day of Resurrection.
changed_reading.after: A request to locate the rising event within an otherwise open span of time.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same asking construction can make the named day the thing being demanded, not merely the topic of neutral inquiry.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sought-object branch of asking combines with an event-day and a rising-to-action image, allowing أَيَّانَ to sound like a challenge for the severe event to commence.

activation_trace.role: The sought request turns the question from information-seeking toward demanding the requested thing itself.
A severe event-day makes the day a happening to be confronted rather than a calendar unit.
Rising with resolve to undertake a matter supplies the challenged event's onset.

changed_reading.after: When will this claimed severe event actually rise and present itself?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The packet's non-dominant split mapping attaches word 1 to س ل ل as well as to ordinary س ء ل.
baseline_models.mechanism: The form-distant split branch images questioning as an attempt to draw the concealed time gently out into disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Gentle hidden drawing-out supplies an exploratory material image for extracting an unrevealed answer.
The open temporal span is the concealed medium from which a determinate moment is being drawn.
The resurrection branch keeps the extraction image attached to the focus event.

changed_reading.before: The speaker asks for a disclosed date.
changed_reading.after: The speaker tries to pull a hidden moment of rising out of concealment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding dispute concerns whether a dispersed hard body can be gathered and precisely restored. That makes the timing question a displaced challenge to the feasibility of embodied rising.

activation_trace.role: The asking branch anchors the changed model in the overt question.
Bodily upright rising lets the named event be tested against bodily reconstruction.
Supposition or calculation supplies the skeptical premise from which the later question proceeds.
Gathering scattered parts supplies the concrete reassembly operation under dispute.
Hard bone supplies the resistant bodily material that must be reassembled.
Effective capacity supplies the power that answers the feasibility challenge.
Completion and sound proportion make restoration exact rather than merely aggregate.
The bodily extremities provide the fine-grained test case for exact restoration.

structural_cues: 75:3-4 moves from the human's calculation about gathered bones to power over the fingertips before 75:5-6 states motive and question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: skeptical calculation, scattered bones, capacity, and exact bodily proportion; inference: the temporal question inherits that feasibility dispute; live alternative: the speaker could accept feasibility yet still ask sincerely for timing.

changed_reading.before: The speaker requests a date for an accepted future event.
changed_reading.after: The speaker disguises a challenge to bodily reassembly as a question about when it will happen.

context_deltas.mechanism: A will to breach moral limits in the open stretch ahead turns uncertainty about the date into usable permission: if the boundary is not scheduled, the questioner treats the future as available for continued transgression.

activation_trace.role: The act of asking becomes the instrument by which temporal uncertainty is maintained.
An open span of time supplies the future interval the questioner wants left usable.
Will and intention supply the motive behind the question rather than mere curiosity.
Deviation from truth and breaching a boundary supply the conduct the open future is meant to protect.
The front or ahead supplies the prospective space into which the transgression is projected.

structural_cues: 75:5 immediately states what the human wants to do ahead, and 75:6 immediately voices the when-question.
75:31-33 later enacts denial, turning away, and a self-displaying return to family, consistent with the stated motive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: intention, boundary-breach, and the space ahead directly precede the question; inference: not knowing when functions as license to continue; live alternative: the question may be mockery without a calculated postponement strategy.

changed_reading.before: The speaker wants information about the future.
changed_reading.after: The speaker asks in order to keep the future unscheduled and morally available.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the whole surah, the same gathering image governs body, cosmos, and recitation. The question seeks one hidden point in time, while the response repeatedly displays controlled assembly across the domains that constitute the event and its announcement.

activation_trace.role: The event-day anchors the cross-domain gatherings as features of the occasion being queried.
Gathering scattered parts supplies the bodily assembly domain.
The same gathering operation supplies the cosmic assembly domain.
The same gathering operation supplies the discourse and recitation domain.

structural_cues: The identical root recurs at 75:3, 75:9, and 75:17 in body, luminary, and recitation sequences on both sides of the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: one gathering root repeats across three explicitly different objects; inference: this repetition answers the timing demand with a display of ordering agency; live alternative: each gathering may serve only its local argument without forming a response to 75:6.

changed_reading.before: The main missing datum is the event's date.
changed_reading.after: The question is enveloped by a motif of controlled assembly, shifting attention from hidden date to the agent who gathers body, cosmos, and recitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate answer is deictic and sequential rather than calendrical: startled sight, a lost lunar light, and gathered luminaries make the event recognizable when it arrives without disclosing a date beforehand.

activation_trace.role: The severe occasion branch lets the queried day be identified by what happens within it.
The rising of the Hour anchors the following signs as the manifestation of the focus event.
The fixed, startled eye supplies the first humanly recognizable onset sign.
The moon and its light supply the luminary whose ordinary visibility fails.
Gathering separated things supplies the culminating cosmic convergence.
The sun supplies the second luminary drawn into that convergence.

structural_cues: فَإِذَا at 75:7 directly follows أَيَّانَ at 75:6 and opens a chained 75:7-9 sequence rather than a numbered date.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a direct fa-idha transition and ordered visual signs; inference: recognitional sequence is the answer-form appropriate to the question; live alternative: the signs may describe consequences after the onset rather than answer when it begins.

changed_reading.before: A valid answer would name a time.
changed_reading.after: The surah answers when by showing the unmistakable sequence through which the day will identify itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human's next question shifts from when to where escape is possible; the denial of refuge and assertion of a fixed destination expose the first question as advance reconnaissance for evasion.

activation_trace.role: The asking branch links the focus interrogative to the later interrogative reaction.
The temporal span is the first axis along which the human searches for room to maneuver.
Flight and escape disclose the practical aim behind the human's interrogative posture.
A refuge supplies the sought protective location and its explicit absence closes that option.
Fixity and settlement replace hoped-for escape with an unavoidable destination.

structural_cues: The same human moves from temporal أَيَّانَ in 75:6 to spatial أَيْنَ in 75:10, followed by no refuge and a destination in 75:11-12.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: paired temporal and spatial questions followed by blocked refuge; inference: the first question already tests an escape route; live alternative: the two questions may simply mark ignorance before and panic after the event.

changed_reading.before: The speaker asks only when the event will happen.
changed_reading.after: The speaker probes time before later probing space, searching in both dimensions for an exit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root's valuation branch is activated by a report that sorts what was advanced and delayed, a self that supplies its own evidence, and excuses that fail to displace that evidence. The queried rising becomes an appraisal-session.

activation_trace.role: Value and appraisal supply the exploratory forensic operation performed at the named rising.
The severe occasion supplies the bounded session in which appraisal occurs.
A delivered report supplies disclosure of the human's record.
Advancing something forward supplies one temporal ledger column.
Deferring something to a later time supplies the contrasting ledger column.
The self as the thing itself supplies an inescapable internal witness.
Excuse and exculpation supply the attempted counter-evidence that fails to erase self-knowledge.

structural_cues: The opening self-reproaching soul at 75:2 and the report-self-excuse sequence at 75:13-15 bracket the focus with accountability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: report, before/after sorting, self-witness, and excuses; inference: these activate ق و م's appraisal branch as a forensic valuation; live alternative: appraisal may be only a lexical resonance while the passage independently describes judgment.

changed_reading.after: When will my standing become the session in which my temporally ordered record is appraised?

context_deltas.mechanism: The later speech sequence opposes hasty tongue-motion with a controlled order of gathering, reciting, following, and explaining. By analogy, the focus question becomes an attempt to force disclosure ahead of its appointed sequence.

activation_trace.role: Asking supplies the speech act whose demand for disclosure is being re-evaluated.
Movement opposed to stillness supplies the premature physical impulse of speech.
The tongue as speech-organ localizes impatience in vocal production.
Hastening and bringing forward supply the temporal error shared with demanding a hidden date now.
Gathering separated material supplies the first stage of controlled disclosure.
Reading and recitation supply the second stage controlled by the revealer.
Following behind supplies the recipient's proper temporal posture.
Clarifying meaning by speech supplies the final stage rather than an answer seized prematurely.

structural_cues: 75:16-19 gives an explicit ordered chain: do not move the tongue to hasten, then gathering, recitation, following, and explanation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: prohibited haste followed by a controlled disclosure sequence; inference: that sequence analogically diagnoses the focus asker's demand for timing; live alternative: 75:16-19 addresses a different recipient and need not characterize the human of 75:6.

changed_reading.before: The question's problem lies only in skeptical content.
changed_reading.after: The question also performs an impatient speech posture that tries to outrun the proper order of disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Love clings to what is brought forward while the later realm is abandoned. The question's temporal adverb therefore reveals a preference structure: only the immediate feels actionable, so the unscheduled later event is treated as negligible.

activation_trace.role: Asking anchors the moralized temporal preference in the focus speech act.
The open temporal span supplies the later horizon being discounted.
Love fixed in the heart supplies attachment rather than a merely intellectual timing error.
Hastening and bringing forward supply the privileged immediacy of the present realm.
Leaving something supplies the active abandonment of the competing horizon.
Deferral to a later time supplies the horizon the questioner refuses to weight.

structural_cues: 75:20-21 is an explicit balanced contrast between loving the immediate and leaving the later realm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: heart-attachment, immediacy, active leaving, and laterness; inference: this contrast supplies the motive encoded in asking when; live alternative: the plural audience at 75:20-21 may broaden beyond the singular human questioner.

changed_reading.after: The speaker's when exposes an affective discounting of whatever is not immediate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later death sequence supplies a near, bodily threshold: arrival at an endpoint, desperate intervention, separation, bodily entanglement, and a drive toward the Lord. The universal day is encountered personally before it can remain an abstract distant date.

activation_trace.role: The severe occasion branch permits the universal day to be approached through an individual's terminal occasion.
Resurrection keeps the personal death threshold oriented toward the focus event rather than reducing it to ordinary dying.
Reaching an endpoint supplies the moment at which abstract futurity becomes immediate bodily fact.
A protective incantation supplies the desperate search for intervention at the threshold.
The collarbone where breath climbs materially couples the healer-root to the preceding bodily limit.
Separation between two things supplies the recognized rupture of death.
Wrapping one thing around another supplies the body's terminal entanglement and loss of free motion.
Driving and herding supply compulsory movement toward the final destination.

structural_cues: The branchless ت ر ق occurrence at 75:26 is used only structurally: reaching the collarbones begins the uninterrupted chain through 75:30.
75:30 repeats the destination toward the Lord already stated at 75:12.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: an ordered terminal bodily process ending in compulsory movement toward the Lord; inference: this is the questioner's personally nearest encounter with the queried day; live alternative: individual death anticipates but is not temporally identical with the Resurrection.

changed_reading.before: The day is a remote universal date.
changed_reading.after: For the questioner, when becomes the bodily endpoint at which escape closes and the drive toward resurrection begins.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing origin-to-life sequence changes the axis of inquiry. Formation from seminal fluid, creative completion, and effective power over lost life make the decisive issue not the withheld date but whether the agent can perform resurrection.

activation_trace.role: The asking branch anchors the contrast between the question actually posed and the issue answered at the close.
Resurrection identifies the act whose possibility the creation sequence establishes.
A drop of clear seminal fluid supplies the materially slight origin of the questioning human.
Seminal substance from which form is determined supplies the transition from matter to designed body.
Creative origination supplies the prior act used as evidence for recreation.
Completion and sound proportion supply the finished form produced from that origin.
Effective capacity to carry an act through supplies the closing criterion that replaces timetable speculation.
Ensouled living existence supplies the state to be restored.
Loss of force and life supplies the condition over which recreative capacity must prevail.

structural_cues: 75:36 repeats the human's calculating posture, 75:37-39 narrates origin and formation, and 75:40 closes with a capacity question rather than a date.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: slight origin, determined formation, completed creation, capacity, life, and death; inference: the closing rhetorical question corrects the axis of 75:6 from when to can; live alternative: proof of possibility answers skepticism but intentionally leaves the timing question unanswered.

changed_reading.before: The unresolved issue is when resurrection occurs.
changed_reading.after: The when-question is exposed as a distraction from demonstrated capacity to recreate and restore life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant س ل ل split target rather than the ordinary parse of يَسْـَٔلُ. It remains anchored to focus word 1 and gains a visible material echo from the seminal-origin sequence; downstream prose should label it split-root wordplay or latent activation, never a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 1 is explicitly mapped in the packet to root_000736, whose extracted-lineage branch can interact with the questioner's narrated origin.

activation_trace.role: Extracted lineage or essence turns the questioning word into a material mirror of the questioner's own derivation.
The seminal drop supplies the slight extracted material from which the questioner begins.
Seminal substance from which form is determined completes the origin mirror.

changed_reading.before: A human tries to extract the hidden date from the revealer.
changed_reading.after: The would-be extractor is himself an extracted, determined essence whose origin already testifies to the revealer's power.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates ق و م's image of an intact but sightless 'standing eye' inside قِيَٰمَةِ. It remains anchored to focus word 4 and is triggered immediately by the fixed eye and sight at 75:7; downstream prose should present it as a visual root resonance, not as the denotation of Resurrection.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun at word 4 carries root ق و م, whose packet inventory includes a standing eye whose globe remains while sight is gone.

activation_trace.role: The intact but sightless standing eye supplies an odd bodily image latent in the focus root.
The eye becoming fixed and startled activates the standing-eye image immediately after the question.
Ordinary visual perception supplies the faculty whose failure distinguishes an intact eye from functioning sight.

changed_reading.before: The Day of Rising is followed by a startled gaze.
changed_reading.after: As a contained visual resonance, the Day's 'standing' is first registered in an eye that remains present while usable sight collapses.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it hears a hostile timing question through the branch of granting or fulfilling a request. It stays anchored to the focus asking-root and is strengthened by the closing capacity to revive the dead; downstream prose should frame it as rhetorical reversal, not as a claim that the verb itself means fulfillment here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus asking-root at word 1 includes a branch for fulfilling a request, while word 4 names resurrection.

activation_trace.role: Fulfilling a request supplies the reversal in which the challenged event is treated as the questioner's own demanded object.
Resurrection specifies the dangerous object whose fulfillment is being challenged.
Effective capacity guarantees that fulfillment is not blocked by inability.
Living, ensouled existence supplies the state that can be restored.
Loss of life supplies the condition from which the requested resurrection will be fulfilled.

changed_reading.before: The skeptic challenges the event to occur.
changed_reading.after: The challenge is rhetorically recast as a request for the very event whose fulfillment will expose the requester.

strongest_changes: The neutral timing question became a feasibility challenge and a strategy for keeping the future morally open.
The immediate fa-idha sequence answered with recognizable signs rather than a calendar date.
Repeated gathering of body, luminaries, and recitation shifted attention from hidden timing to controlled assembly.
The death sequence localized the remote universal day as a personal bodily threshold with no escape.
The closing creation argument displaced when with the demonstrated question of capacity.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package made long-range mechanisms visible: three domains share the same gathering root, temporal impatience recurs in speech and attachment to the immediate, and the opening timing demand is finally answered by an origin-to-resurrection capacity argument. The split-root extraction/origin mirror and the standing-eye resonance remained live only with explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 75:16-19 is meant to characterize the focus questioner's impatience or addresses a separate recipient without that analogy.
Whether individual death in 75:26-30 functions as an answer to when or only as an anticipatory scene distinct from resurrection.
How much interpretive weight the valuation branch of ق و م can bear beyond the independently clear accountability sequence.
The non-dominant س ل ل activations are packet-authorized but remain form-distant wordplay rather than ordinary morphology.
